thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: High TPM spike for model family `orpheus13b` observed. 10m TPM rolling avg 2.1x baseline, errors rising. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/d/orpheus13b
alex: Ack. I'm oncall. Checking current tpm/rpm and error logs.
maria: seeing KV cache miss rate jump, tail latency > 1.2s on 95th for seq>1024.
chris: any customer reports? I see a handful of 502s from edge.
product-ops: acme-inc (prod) and betalabs (sandbox) have reported 5xx. Pinged both.
alex: plan: 1) Immediate temp per-model TPM carve: lower `orpheus13b` from 420 -> 90 TPM. 2) Enable per-customer burst caps for high-volume accounts. 3) Disable function-calling for orpheus13b (reduces KV mem and cpu). 4) Monitor 15m and reassess. :arrow_forward:
maria: agree. disabling funcall should help kernel pressure.
chris: I'm going to run the quota update now. Running:
```
redwoodctl quota update --model orpheus13b --tpm 90 --rpm 5400 --reason "live mitigation - oncall alex"
redwoodctl feature toggle --model orpheus13b --feature funcall --state off
```
chris: applied quota cmd, waiting for API ack.
deploy-bot: Quota update accepted. Change ID: Q-20260317-9987. Propagating config to regions.
chris: funcall toggle returned 200, feature disabled across us-west/us-east-eu.
alex: great. applying per-customer burst caps for top callers (script):
```
redwoodctl customer cap apply --selector "tokens_1m > 100000" --burst 20 --window 60s
```
alex: policy applied to 7 customers, including acme-inc and betalabs.
product-ops: acme-inc acknowledged mitigation, saw immediate 503->200 improvement on a few calls.
maria: metrics: 95th latency down ~350ms, error rate down 70% in last 3m. TPM dropped to ~110.
sre-oncall: any plans for longer-term? Do we need to route to a fallback model family?
alex: if stable in 30m, we'll keep limits and roll a canary where we re-enable funcall for a subset. if errors resurge, fallback to `orpheus13b-small` for non-critical customers.
product-ops: logged impacted customers + contact history, will open P1 CS ticket for acme-inc.
alex: I'll handoff to next oncall in 25m. tagging @sre-oncall for awareness. :memo:
maria: saving heap+kv snapshots and tracing data to s3://redwood-incidents/3619876543/
chris: monitoring dashboards, will post periodic updates.
alex: thanks team. keep chatter here, brief updates only. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident window started 2026-03-17T15:22:23Z — mitigation in place.
